verdict.rationale: Reflect's docs say it automatically creates a new daily note every day for journaling. Several capture paths route into it by default: web bookmarks and highlights, audio-memo transcriptions, and deep-link and API appends to today's daily note. Nothing in the pack shows daily notes being pre-filled from a template, which is a core part of the story. Missing for 10: template-based pre-filling of daily notes, explicit documentation that the daily note is the app's default landing view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I get an automatic daily note for each day, pre-filled from a template, as the default landing place for journaling and capture

citations.quote: Tools like Reflect will create a new daily note for you everyday for you to journal in.
The link and your highlights will automatically be added to your daily note.
After a few minutes their transcription will be added to your daily note.
Appends text to the first list in today's daily note.
